questions.q: How often did the narrator eat sweets before the experiment?
questions.e: In the video: "Pojedem nešto slatko svakog dana bez izuzetka." — I eat something sweet every day, without exception.

questions.q: What does she consider the worst thing about sugar?
o: It is addictive, like a drug
It spoils the taste of coffee
questions.e: In the video: "a to je da je šećer na neki način droga." — and that is that sugar is, in a way, a drug.

questions.q: What happened to her skin and energy because of sweets?
o: Energy dropped and skin got worse
Skin dried out, energy stayed the same
questions.e: In the video: "nivo energije mi je značajno opao i koža mi se pogoršala." — my energy level dropped significantly and my skin got worse.

questions.q: What does she say is the worst of the experiment's rules?
questions.e: In the video: "I što je najgore od svega, nema šećera u kafi." — And what's worst of all, no sugar in coffee.

questions.q: What is the recommended daily sugar intake?
questions.e: In the video: "Preporučen dnevni unos šećera je 25 grama" — The recommended daily sugar intake is 25 grams

questions.q: What helped her handle sweet cravings in the evening?
questions.e: In the video: "Uveče bih napravila sebi šolju čaja od kamilice ili nane" — In the evening I'd make myself a cup of chamomile or mint tea

questions.q: What happened to the taste of everyday foods?
questions.e: In the video: "jeste da su sada stvari koje mi ranije nisu bile slatke," — is that things that weren't sweet to me before

questions.q: How much weight did she lose?
questions.e: In the video: "Izgubila sam jedan kilogram" — I lost one kilogram

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Prekomjeran unos šećera može izazvati *gojaznost*, dijabetes, probleme sa srcem,
questions.e: gojaznost — obesity.

questions.q: Nema suhog voća, nema voćnih *sokova*, nema gaziranih pića, nema alkohola,
questions.e: sok — juice; sokova — of juices.

questions.q: Nema vještačkih *zaslađivača*, poput aspartama, stevije.
questions.e: zaslađivač — sweetener.

questions.q: Uveče bih napravila sebi šolju čaja od *kamilice* ili nane
questions.e: kamilica — chamomile.

questions.q: Osjećala sam se kao da su mi sve *lađe* potonule
questions.e: lađa — ship; the idiom means everything went down the drain.

questions.q: i samo sam željela da se pokrijem *ćebetom* preko glave i da prespavam cio dan,
questions.e: ćebe — blanket.

questions.q: Imala sam ovdje jednu *bubuljicu*, međutim neke ozbiljnije upalne procese na licu uopšte nemam.
questions.e: bubuljica — pimple.

questions.q: Danas za ručak imamo falafel, *špargle* i salatu.
questions.e: špargla — asparagus.

questions.q: Osim ukoliko ne živite u ___, do sada ste već naučili
questions.e: After «u» (where?) use the locative: u pećini.

questions.q: Nema šećera u ___.
questions.e: After «u» (where?) use the locative: u kafi.

questions.q: Prvi korak je bio da nađem sve što imam u ___
questions.e: u kući — «in the house», locative.

questions.q: Krenula sam da kuvam zdravije obroke sa više ___
questions.e: After «više» (more) use the genitive: više zelenila.

questions.q: Ono što sam morala da uradim je da izbalansiram svoju ___
questions.e: Direct object — accusative: svoju dijetu.

questions.q: Kažite mi šta vi mislite o ___ ovome
questions.e: After «o» (about what?) use the locative: o svemu ovome.

questions.q: Sa pozitivne ___, baš sam zadovoljna
questions.e: «sa» + genitive: sa pozitivne strane — «on the positive side».

questions.q: Danas jedem špagete sa ___ od pečuraka i parmezanom
questions.e: After «sa» (with what?) use the instrumental: sa sosom.
